data.name: Foushee
data.gender_notes: Foushee is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Foushee is a female name meaning 'little bird'. The name evokes images of grace, freedom, and delicate beauty. In Christian tradition, the dove is a symbol of the Holy Spirit and new beginnings. The name Foushee carries the meaning “Little Bird” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Foushee usually hope their child will grow to embody little bird and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the gentle, soaring spirit of the dove, symbolizing faith, hope, and divine inspiration.
data.etymology: Foushee belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Bird.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Foushee total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: פושה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew word פושה (pōšhā), meaning ‘refreshment, salvation’. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a child, evoking the idea of renewal and deliverance from hardship.

in_greek.name: Φούση
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Foushee in its Greek form, Φούση (Phousē), is derived from the Greek word φούς (phous), meaning ‘wind, breath’. This name carries the idea of the breath of God and the renewing power of the Holy Spirit.

in_latin.name: Fouesse
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin form of Foushee is Fouesse. This name is derived from the Latin word for victory or strength, which reflects the power and triumph of God in the life of the one bearing this name.

in_english.name: Foushee
in_english.long_meaning: The English name Foushee is a combination of the words ‘God’ and ‘refresher’ or ‘savior’. It is a meaningful name that carries the idea of God’s provision, deliverance, and renewal.

data.cultural_impact: The name Foushee, with its roots in Greek mythology, carries a sense of grace and elegance reminiscent of ancient cultures. With increasing globalization, it may resonate beyond the realm of Christianity as a name signifying the qualities associated with the little bird - resilience, agility, and vulnerability.

The name becomes a reminder of the spiritual journey of faith, growth, and transformation.
